requirements.statement: For information that an image or group of images gives by shape, size or position, the other means of obtaining it is relevant.

citations.quote: Cette règle est-elle implémentée de façon pertinente ?
pour chaque image ou ensemble d’images, l’information ne doit pas être donnée uniquement par la forme, taille ou position
Retrouver dans le document les informations d’une image données par la forme, la taille ou la position

routes.statement: The other means conveys the information in every context of use and to every user.

citations.quote: vérifier que le moyen alternatif de récupérer cette information est pertinent, c’est-à-dire qu’il permet de transmettre l’information dans tous les contextes de consultation et pour tous les utilisateurs

rationale.text: The test asks whether the other means of obtaining information that an image or group of images gives by shape, size or position is relevant. The methodology defines relevant as conveying the information in every context of use and to every user. That needs the information and the other means to be understood, and every context of use to be considered, which is judgment. The same judgment finds the elements the test applies to: the glossary gives three examples of information given by shape, size or position and extends to any similar graphic effect. No axe rule is tagged for this test, and no deterministic check can examine relevance, so no check is linked and the candidate is none. Whether another means exists at all is the question of test 10.9.2, judged there on its own wording. The methodology does not name an assistive technology, so assistive_tech is not listed, although conveying the information to every user may in practice be checked with one. Applicability is judgment: a page may hold images that give no information by shape, size or position, and telling them apart is judgment, so code cannot decide that the test does not apply. Needs is empty: images and their surroundings are examined on the page as loaded. Information shown only after an interaction is examined on a declared state.
